name: Store RAM — why the server holds 3.3 GB

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb.label: Store RAM — why the server holds 3.3 GB

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--n.label: Measured 2026-08-28 on the live deployed server: ONE process, 3.3 GB resident, flat over time. Not ghosts (deploy fixed that), not a leak. Every byte is an in-memory index rebuilt from disk at every boot and then held forever.

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--p.label: engine.ts
store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--p.description: The one store engine. Boot: chunked re-index of every file from byte 0 (no persisted index). Retains the result forever.

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--p.label: HEAVY_PAYLOAD_KINDS = { transcriptLine } only
lines: Only transcriptLine gets lazy payloads. Receipts, journal and traces keep FULL payloads in RAM.

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--p.description: openFoundationTranscriptStore() — replays ALL transcript, send and delivery facts at boot

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--p.label: holds ALL 3 GB of lines + every event, forever
lines: line 65: lines = new Map over every TranscriptLine
line 187: every history query copies the whole map, then filters

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--p.label: transcript-observation.ts
store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--p.description: Watches transcripts + traces for agent health

callouts.text: Today the UI gets history from the full in-memory map — it works BECAUSE everything is in RAM.
After the fix, history pages through the byte-range index — every old line is still reachable on demand. Nothing is cut off.
RISK: only if the fix naively keeps 'the last N lines' would history look cut off at an arbitrary point. The fix must page, not truncate.

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--t.label: 1. Lazy payloads for receipts, journal, traces
lines: Extend HEAVY_PAYLOAD_KINDS — envelope in RAM, payload re-read by byte range on demand. Pattern already exists.

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--t.label: 2. TranscriptState: index, not haystack
lines: lines: Map<id, full record> -> Map<id, byte range>. History queries become paged index lookups.

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--t.label: 3. Persist the index across restarts
lines: Boot validates a saved index instead of re-parsing 4.6 GB of JSONL every time.

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--t.label: 4. Rotate transcriptLines.jsonl
lines: 3 GB append-only doubles every few weeks. Cold history moves to an archive file.

store-ram-why-the-server-holds-3-3-gb--p.description: Walks provider transcript dirs every second. Burns CPU/disk — NOT the RAM problem.
